effect_description_eng: [Main] [Once Per Turn] By suspending 1 of your green Digimon, you may play 1 Digimon card with [Vegetation], [Plant] or [Fairy] in any of its traits and 3000 DP or less from your hand without paying its memory cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an effect suspends one of your Digimon, gain 1 memory.
